subject: maths
topic: Fractions, decimals, approximations, significant figures and percentages

kept.q: Evaluate 2/5 + 1/4, leaving your answer as a decimal.
kept.pidgin: 2/5 be 0.4 and 1/4 be 0.25. If you add dem together, 0.4 + 0.25 go give 0.65.

kept.q: Amina's monthly salary was increased from ₦45,000 to ₦54,000. What was the percentage increase in her salary?
kept.pidgin: The increase na 54,000 - 45,000 = 9,000. To find percentage, you do (9,000/45,000) x 100 = 20%.

kept.q: A trader bought goods worth ₦8,000. He sold 3/4 of the goods at a profit of 25% and the remaining 1/4 at a loss of 10%. Find his overall percentage profit on the whole transaction.
kept.explanation: Cost of 3/4 portion = N6,000, sold at 25% profit = N7,500. Cost of 1/4 portion = N2,000, sold at 10% loss = N1,800. Total selling price = N9,300, so profit = N1,300. Percentage profit = (1,300/8,000) x 100 = 16.25%.
kept.pidgin: 3/4 of the goods cost N6,000, e sell am for 25% profit wey be N7,500. The remaining 1/4 cost N2,000, e sell am for 10% loss wey be N1,800. Total money wey e get na N9,300, so profit na N1,300, wey be (1,300/8,000) x 100 = 16.25%.

q.explanation: The first two significant figures are 9 and 8. The next digit is 7, which rounds the 8 up to 9, giving 0.0099.
q.pidgin: The first two important figures na 9 and 8. The next number be 7, e go round up the 8 to 9, so e go be 0.0099.
